_doc: Explicit per-combo EXPECTED-TIER whitelist for the Commander Spellbook combo-recall bench. STATELESS INVARIANT: for EACH eligible combo (every card has a gold fixture), the engine's CURRENT reconstruction tier MUST equal the expectedTier pinned here. ANY drift fails loudly and per-combo: a REGRESSION (e.g. Green->Amber, Amber->Missed) is a real coverage loss; an IMPROVEMENT (e.g. Missed->Amber) also fails, with the message 'update the pin for <combo>' — a coverage gain is a deliberate, reviewed pin edit, never a silent moving baseline. A combo present in the run but absent here (or vice-versa) also fails (the whitelist is a list of NAMES, not an aggregate count). The aggregate recall numbers in bench-report.json are a DERIVED REPORT (regenerated by `dotnet run -- --write`), NOT the gate; this file is the gate. Seeded from the run on 2026-06-16 (5 Green / 18 Amber / 10 Missed of 33 eligible).

This is THE combo in the GREEN sentinel exemplar gravecrawler-x-pitiless-plunderer-x-ashnod-s-altar-aristocrat-recursion-green (interaction-judge-verified GREEN); reach 10 aligns the bench with that established tier. §8 machinery unchanged; certified infinite (CR 701.21 sac -> CR 601.3e recast), matches Commander Spellbook ground truth

The {B} pip is paid by a loop-produced Treasure (any mana, CR 107.4c), not by Ashnod's colorless (which the per-colour balance would floor to Amber). RE-PIN (2026-07-18, was wrongly 'Amber'): the prior Amber never actually used Night of Souls' Betrayal — the cycle the engine found was 'Gravecrawler::emit:returntobattlefield:self => Pitiless Plunderer::sac:artifact:treasure:controlled', i.e. a recast Gravecrawler (a Zombie creature) satisfying a 'sacrifice a Treasure' cost, which is impossible (Gravecrawler is never an artifact/Treasure). That was the exact false-positive the RecastSatisfies subtype guard in d7a8b2c1 (fix(interaction): prune coarse self-return from subtype-specific sacs) correctly pruned; the prune just happened to also remove this combo's only cycle, unmasking that the pin was never verifying the real combo mechanism. The real loop needs Night of Souls' Betrayal's -1/-1 to kill a freshly-recast Gravecrawler via state-based action (1/0 toughness) so it dies-and-recasts with no sac outlet at all; the engine has no P/T-lethality reasoning hop for that ('modifyPT' is an inert port today) per libs/mast-interaction/docs/aristocrat-recursion-scope.md §1 row 2 / §4 Decision 5, which predicted exactly 'AMBER at best, likely Missed... out of scope' for this combo when the recursion arm was scoped. Honest current tier is Missed; upgrading to Amber/Green needs a real P/T-lethality flow arm, not a pin edit.
